Definition: a Japhletite or descendant of Japhlet
BiblicalUsage: The Japhletites were the family of Japhlet, and their coast marked the border of Ephraim as it went down westward toward Gezer and the sea. The name of one man became the name of a boundary.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God draws borders by families, and a household can give its name to the land.
